decision_basis: ADM binding and CALCRL/RAMP reconstitution with cAMP and receptor-perturbation assays support qualified-high relay/function evidence while retaining RAMP2/RAMP3 specificity.
Agrin-LRP4 contact, LRP4/MuSK complex activation, MuSK phosphorylation, and neuromuscular synapse function support qualified-high complex relay/function evidence, not direct Agrin-MuSK binding.
Exact CD80/CD28 binding and PI3K/sphingomyelinase-linked AP-1/NF-kB T-cell costimulation support qualified-high relay/function evidence integrated with TCR signal 1.
Exact CD86/CD28 binding and T-cell costimulation support qualified-high relay/function evidence while preserving TCR dependence and B7-2 homodimer context.
